description:
GISGP Lite (a 24-hour pass, a 7-day pass or a monthly plan) — pass the api_key of that
    account (or Authorization: Bearer). a legal description
    → where it is: `q` like "T2N R3E Sec 14", "NW¼ SE¼ Sec 12 T3N R4W", "Township 1 North, Range 2
    East" or BLM-coded "1460N 0920W SEC 8"; `state` the two-letter code (tried in every PLSS state
    when empty). Returns JSON {ok, results: [{label, state, lat, lon, bbox, plssid, geometry…}],
    read_as, notes}.
name: plss_find
